What's the daily meal limit when I travel for client visits?

name: get_policy
content: {"ok": true, "id": "POL-EXP-01", "title": "Expenses", "text": "Submit expenses in the HR portal within 30 days, with a receipt for anything over $25. Meals while travelling are covered up to $75 per day. Your manager approves expenses; a single expense over $1,000 also needs your department head. Alcohol is not reimbursed unless it is part of an approved client event."}

name: get_policy
content: {"ok": true, "id": "POL-TRV-01", "title": "Business travel", "text": "Book flights and hotels through the travel desk at least 14 days ahead where possible. Economy class for flights under 6 hours; premium economy is allowed for longer flights. Travel needs your manager's approval before booking."}
